qe: What specific concentration of phenol is used as an antiseptic, and what concentration acts as a disinfectant?
qh: फिनोल की किस विशिष्ट सांद्रता का उपयोग एंटीसेप्टिक के रूप में किया जाता है, और कौन सी सांद्रता कीटाणुनाशक (disinfectant) के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: 1.0 percent as antiseptic, 0.2 percent as disinfectant
0.5 percent as antiseptic, 2.0 percent as disinfectant
0.2 percent as antiseptic, 1.0 percent as disinfectant
2.0 percent as antiseptic, 0.5 percent as disinfectant
e: Explanation: Dilute solutions of some disinfectants can be used as antiseptics. For example, a 0.2 percent solution of phenol is an antiseptic, while its 1.0 percent solution acts as a disinfectant.

qe: Which of the following compounds is commonly added to toilet soaps to impart antiseptic properties?
qh: टॉयलेट साबुन में एंटीसेप्टिक गुण प्रदान करने के लिए आमतौर पर निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक मिलाया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Bithionol (also called bithional) is a chemical compound specifically added to commercial soaps to impart antiseptic properties and reduce microbial growth on the skin.

qe: What is the primary difference between antiseptics and antibiotics regarding their mode of administration?
qh: उनके प्रशासन के तरीके (mode of administration) के संबंध में एंटीसेप्टिक्स और एंटीबायोटिक्स के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Antibiotics are applied to inanimate objects, whereas antiseptics are ingested.
Antiseptics can be ingested safely, whereas antibiotics are strictly for topical use.
Antiseptics cannot be ingested and are applied to living tissues, whereas antibiotics can be ingested.
Both antiseptics and antibiotics must be strictly injected intravenously.
e: Explanation: Antiseptics are applied externally to living tissues such as wounds, cuts, and diseased skin surfaces (e.g., soframicine). Unlike antibiotics, antiseptic medicines cannot be ingested.

qe: Birth control pills essentially contain a mixture of derivatives of which two sex hormones?
qh: जन्म नियंत्रण गोलियों (birth control pills) में अनिवार्य रूप से किन दो सेक्स हार्मोन के व्युत्पन्नों का मिश्रण होता है?
e: Explanation: Chemical substances used to check pregnancy are called birth control pills. They essentially contain a mixture of synthetic estrogen and progesterone derivatives.

qe: What is the specific physiological function of progesterone derivatives present in birth control pills?
qh: जन्म नियंत्रण गोलियों में मौजूद प्रोजेस्टेरोन व्युत्पन्नों का विशिष्ट शारीरिक कार्य क्या है?
o: They enhance the development of the uterine lining.
They stimulate the immediate release of eggs.
They increase the production of testosterone.
e: Explanation: In birth control pills, it is known that progesterone suppresses ovulation, preventing the release of an egg, while estrogen helps to control the menstrual cycle.

qe: Norethindrone is a common component of birth control pills. How is it chemically classified?
qh: नोरेथिंड्रोन जन्म नियंत्रण गोलियों का एक सामान्य घटक है। इसे रासायनिक रूप से कैसे वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Explanation: Norethindrone is a widely used synthetic progesterone derivative found in commonly used oral contraceptive pills.

qe: Novestrol, frequently used in combination with norethindrone in contraceptive pills, represents which class of compounds?
qh: गर्भनिरोधक गोलियों में नोरेथिंड्रोन के साथ संयोजन में अक्सर इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला नोवेस्ट्रोल, किस वर्ग के यौगिकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
e: Explanation: Some commonly used birth control pills contain a mixture of norethindrone (a progesterone derivative) and novestrol (which is an estrogen).

qe: Aspirin is chemically known as 2-acetoxybenzoic acid. Which compound is acetylated to synthesize aspirin?
qh: एस्पिरिन को रासायनिक रूप से 2-एसिटोक्सीबेंजोइक एसिड के रूप में जाना जाता है। एस्पिरिन को संश्लेषित करने के लिए किस यौगिक का एसिटिलीकरण (acetylation) किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Aspirin is prepared by the acetylation of salicylic acid using acetic anhydride in the presence of an acid catalyst ($H^+$), yielding 2-acetoxybenzoic acid (Aspirin) and acetic acid.

qe: What is the biochemical mechanism through which aspirin effectively relieves pain?
qh: वह जैव रासायनिक तंत्र क्या है जिसके माध्यम से एस्पिरिन प्रभावी ढंग से दर्द से राहत दिलाती है?
o: It accelerates the degradation of noradrenaline in the brain.
It inhibits the synthesis of prostaglandins that stimulate inflammation.
It acts as an antagonist at histamine receptor sites.
It competitively binds to the allosteric site of pain receptors.
e: Explanation: Aspirin inhibits the synthesis of compounds known as prostaglandins. Prostaglandins stimulate inflammation in the tissues and cause pain. By blocking them, aspirin effectively relieves pain.

qe: Apart from its antipyretic and analgesic properties, why is aspirin widely used to prevent heart attacks?
qh: अपने ज्वरनाशक (antipyretic) और एनाल्जेसिक गुणों के अलावा, एस्पिरिन का व्यापक रूप से दिल के दौरे को रोकने के लिए क्यों उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Because it decreases systemic blood pressure.
Because it has an anti-blood clotting action.
e: Explanation: Aspirin has an anti-blood clotting action, which prevents blood platelet coagulation. Because of this property, it is widely prescribed to prevent heart attacks.

qe: Which classification of drugs is considered the most useful for medicinal chemists engaged in designing new medicines?
qh: नई दवाओं को डिजाइन करने में लगे औषधीय रसायनज्ञों (medicinal chemists) के लिए दवाओं का कौन सा वर्गीकरण सबसे उपयोगी माना जाता है?
o: Classification on the basis of chemical structure
Classification on the basis of pharmacological effect
Classification on the basis of molecular targets
Classification on the basis of drug action
e: Explanation: Drugs possessing some common structural features may have the same mechanism of action on a specific drug target (like proteins, nucleic acids). Classification based on molecular targets is the most useful for medicinal chemists designing new compounds.

qe: Which classification system of drugs provides doctors with the whole range of drugs available for treating a particular disease?
qh: दवाओं की कौन सी वर्गीकरण प्रणाली डॉक्टरों को किसी विशेष बीमारी के इलाज के लिए उपलब्ध दवाओं की पूरी श्रृंखला प्रदान करती है?
e: Explanation: Classification based on pharmacological effect is more useful for doctors because it groups drugs by their therapeutic use (e.g., all analgesics kill pain, all antiseptics kill microorganisms), providing a whole range of options for a specific disease.

qe: Sulphonamides are grouped together based on their chemical structure. What pharmacological activity is common to mostly all sulphonamides?
qh: सल्फोनामाइड्स (Sulphonamides) को उनकी रासायनिक संरचना के आधार पर एक साथ समूहीकृत किया जाता है। अधिकांश सल्फोनामाइड्स में कौन सी औषधीय गतिविधि आम है?
e: Explanation: Drugs have been classified on the basis of chemical structures because those with common structural features often share similar activity. For example, all sulphonamides possessing a specific structural feature are mostly antibacterial.

qe: Noradrenaline is a vital neurotransmitter involved in mood regulation. A clinical drop in the levels of noradrenaline is primarily associated with which condition?
qh: नोराड्रेनालाईन मूड नियंत्रण में शामिल एक महत्वपूर्ण न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर है। नोराड्रेनालाईन के स्तर में नैदानिक गिरावट मुख्य रूप से किस स्थिति से जुड़ी है?
e: Explanation: Noradrenaline plays an important role in mood changes. If its level in the body is low, the message transfer process becomes slow, and the person suffers from depression.

qe: How do antidepressant drugs biochemically counteract the effects of depression?
qh: एंटीडिप्रेसेंट दवाएं अवसाद (depression) के प्रभावों का जैव रासायनिक रूप से कैसे मुकाबला करती हैं?
o: By rapidly accelerating the synthesis of new noradrenaline.
By inhibiting the enzymes that catalyze the degradation of noradrenaline.
By competitively binding to the active site of dopamine receptors.
By acting as a direct substitute for the missing neurotransmitter.
e: Explanation: Antidepressant drugs inhibit the enzymes which catalyze the degradation of noradrenaline. When the enzyme is inhibited, noradrenaline is slowly metabolized and can activate its receptor for a longer period, counteracting depression.

qe: Salvarsan was the first effective synthetic medicine discovered for the treatment of a specific disease. Which disease does it treat?
qh: सल्वारसन (Salvarsan) किसी विशिष्ट बीमारी के इलाज के लिए खोजी गई पहली प्रभावी सिंथेटिक दवा थी। यह किस बीमारी का इलाज करती है?
e: Explanation: Paul Ehrlich investigated arsenic-based structures to produce less toxic substances. Salvarsan was the first effective medicine discovered for the treatment of syphilis, an infectious disease.

qe: Which heavy metal acts as the central active component in the molecular structure of the drug Salvarsan?
qh: दवा सल्वारसन की आणविक संरचना में कौन सी भारी धातु केंद्रीय सक्रिय घटक के रूप में कार्य करती है?
e: Explanation: Salvarsan is an arsenic-containing drug. Paul Ehrlich investigated arsenic-based structures to develop this compound, which features an $As=As$ double bond, specifically for treating syphilis.

qe: The infectious disease Syphilis is caused by which of the following pathogenic bacteria?
qh: संक्रामक रोग सिफलिस (Syphilis) निम्नलिखित में से किस रोगजनक जीवाणु के कारण होता है?
e: Explanation: Syphilis is an acute and chronic infectious disease caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum. It is primarily a sexually transmitted infection.

qe: How is a 'Broad spectrum antibiotic' technically defined in pharmacology?
qh: फार्माकोलॉजी में 'ब्रॉड स्पेक्ट्रम एंटीबायोटिक' (Broad spectrum antibiotic) को तकनीकी रूप से कैसे परिभाषित किया जाता है?
o: It targets only single, specific strains of resistant pathogens.
It exclusively eradicates Gram-negative bacterial strains.
It prevents viral replication inside human host cells.
It is effective against a wide range of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
e: Explanation: Broad spectrum antibiotics are effective against several different types of harmful bacteria, meaning they attack a wide range of both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria.

qe: Which of the following antibiotics is classically categorized as a narrow spectrum antibiotic?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस एंटीबायोटिक को क्लासिक रूप से नैरो स्पेक्ट्रम (narrow spectrum) एंटीबायोटिक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Explanation: Antibiotics effective mainly against either gram-positive or gram-negative bacteria are narrow spectrum. While Chloramphenicol is a broad-spectrum antibiotic, Penicillin-G specifically has a narrow spectrum.

qe: Chloramphenicol is widely utilized in medicine due to its extensive range of action. It belongs to which class of antibiotics?
qh: क्लोरैम्फेनिकॉल का चिकित्सा में इसके व्यापक प्रभाव क्षेत्र के कारण व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है। यह एंटीबायोटिक दवाओं के किस वर्ग से संबंधित है?
e: Explanation: According to the pharmacological classification based on action spectrum, Chloramphenicol is defined as a broad spectrum antibiotic as it acts against a wide range of pathogens.

qe: Which operational definition best describes the medical function of an Analgesic drug?
qh: कौन सी परिचालन परिभाषा एनाल्जेसिक दवा के चिकित्सा कार्य का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करती है?
o: It abolishes pain while causing temporary impairment of consciousness.
It reduces or abolishes pain without causing impairment of consciousness or nervous disturbances.
It induces deep sleep to assist the body in combating mental fatigue.
It triggers localized numbness by destroying nerve endings.
e: Explanation: Analgesics reduce or abolish pain without causing impairment of consciousness, mental confusion, incoordination, paralysis, or some other disturbances of the nervous system.

qe: Which chemical substance released in the human body is primarily responsible for producing hypersensitivity reactions, such as allergies to dust or pollen?
qh: मानव शरीर में जारी कौन सा रासायनिक पदार्थ मुख्य रूप से अतिसंवेदनशीलता प्रतिक्रियाओं (hypersensitivity) का उत्पादन करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है, जैसे धूल या पराग से एलर्जी?
e: Explanation: Histamine is a substance which, upon release in the body, produces hypersensitivity to dust, certain drugs, pollen, etc., leading to allergic reactions.

qe: Equanil is an important chemical compound used in medicine. To which class of neurologically active drugs does it belong?
qh: इक्वैनिल (Equanil) चिकित्सा में उपयोग किया जाने वाला एक महत्वपूर्ण रासायनिक यौगिक है। यह तंत्रिका संबंधी सक्रिय दवाओं के किस वर्ग से संबंधित है?
e: Explanation: Equanil is classified as a tranquilizer. Tranquilizers are chemical compounds used for the treatment of stress, mild, and severe mental diseases.

qe: During the preparation of shaving soaps, a gum called rosin is added. What specific chemical forms from this addition that helps the soap to lather well?
qh: शेविंग साबुन तैयार करते समय, रोसिन (rosin) नामक गोंद मिलाया जाता है। इस जोड़ से कौन सा विशिष्ट रसायन बनता है जो साबुन को अच्छी तरह झाग देने में मदद करता है?
e: Explanation: While preparing shaving soaps, a gum called rosin is added to them. It reacts to form sodium rosinate, which helps the soap to lather exceptionally well.

qe: Glycerol is an essential additive in shaving soaps. What is its primary functional purpose in the formulation?
qh: ग्लिसरॉल शेविंग साबुन में एक आवश्यक योज्य (additive) है। फॉर्मूलेशन में इसका प्राथमिक कार्यात्मक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To act as a water softener by removing calcium ions.
To increase the volume of the lather produced.
To prevent the soap from rapid drying on the skin.
To provide a pleasant artificial fragrance.
e: Explanation: Glycerol is specifically added to shaving soaps to prevent rapid drying, ensuring the lather remains moist and effective during the shaving process.

qe: Liquid dishwashing detergents typically belong to which structural category of synthetic detergents?
qh: तरल डिशवॉशिंग डिटर्जेंट आमतौर पर सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट की किस संरचनात्मक श्रेणी से संबंधित होते हैं?
e: Explanation: Liquid dishwashing detergents are of the non-ionic type. Non-ionic detergents do not contain any ions in their chemical constitution and remove grease and oil by micelle formation.

qe: Non-ionic detergents are synthesized using specific long-chain organic molecules. Which two compounds react to form a standard non-ionic detergent?
qh: गैर-आयनिक (Non-ionic) डिटर्जेंट को विशिष्ट लंबी-श्रृंखला वाले कार्बनिक अणुओं का उपयोग करके संश्लेषित किया जाता है। एक मानक गैर-आयनिक डिटर्जेंट बनाने के लिए किन दो यौगिकों की प्रतिक्रिया होती है?
e: Explanation: Polyethylene glycols are used in the preparation of non-ionic detergents. Specifically, stearic acid reacts with polyethylene glycol to form a liquid non-ionic detergent.

qe: Sodium lauryl sulphate is a very common household cleansing agent. Under which category of detergents is it classified?
qh: सोडियम लॉरिल सल्फेट एक बहुत ही आम घरेलू क्लींजिंग एजेंट है। इसे डिटर्जेंट की किस श्रेणी के तहत वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Explanation: Sodium lauryl sulphate and sodium dodecylbenzenesulphonate are classic examples of anionic detergents, which are sodium salts of sulphonated long-chain alcohols or hydrocarbons.

qe: Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide is widely used in cosmetic products like hair conditioners. What type of detergent is it?
qh: सेटाइलट्रिमिथाइलअमोनियम ब्रोमाइड (Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide) का हेयर कंडीशनर जैसे कॉस्मेटिक उत्पादों में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है। यह किस प्रकार का डिटर्जेंट है?
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents are quaternary ammonium salts of amines with acetates, chlorides, or bromides as anions. Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide is a popular cationic detergent frequently used in hair conditioners.

qe: Which category of synthetic detergents is primarily used in the formulation of modern hair conditioners?
qh: आधुनिक हेयर कंडीशनर के निर्माण में मुख्य रूप से सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट की किस श्रेणी का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents, such as cetyltrimethylammonium bromide, have germicidal properties and positively charged active parts, making them highly effective and popular for use in hair conditioners.

qe: Drugs dynamically interact with biological macromolecules in the human body to induce a response. Which of the following is NOT considered a macromolecular drug target?
qh: प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करने के लिए दवाएं मानव शरीर में जैविक मैक्रोमोलेक्यूल्स के साथ गतिशील रूप से परस्पर क्रिया करती हैं। निम्नलिखित में से किसे मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर ड्रग लक्ष्य (drug target) नहीं माना जाता है?
e: Explanation: Drugs usually interact with biomolecules such as carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids. These are collectively called drug targets. Vitamins are essential nutrients but are not classified as target molecules for drug function.

qe: In pharmacology, what is the specific role of a 'Non-competitive inhibitor' during enzyme interaction?
qh: फार्माकोलॉजी में, एंजाइम इंटरेक्शन के दौरान 'गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी अवरोधक' (Non-competitive inhibitor) की विशिष्ट भूमिका क्या है?
o: It directly competes with the natural substrate for the active catalytic site.
It permanently degrades the enzyme into inactive polypeptide fragments.
It binds to an allosteric site, altering the shape of the active site so the substrate cannot recognize it.
It binds strongly to the natural substrate, preventing it from approaching the enzyme.
e: Explanation: Non-competitive inhibitors do not bind to the active site. Instead, they bind to a different site called the allosteric site. This binding alters the three-dimensional shape of the active site, preventing the natural substrate from attaching.

qe: When an inhibitor attaches to an enzyme to block its catalytic activity, what type of chemical bond is generally formed between them?
qh: जब कोई अवरोधक अपनी उत्प्रेरक गतिविधि को रोकने के लिए किसी एंजाइम से जुड़ता है, तो उनके बीच आम तौर पर किस प्रकार का रासायनिक बंधन बनता है?
o: A very strong permanent covalent bond
A weak bond such as hydrogen bonding or van der Waals interaction
A strictly ionic bond operating in a vacuum
e: Explanation: Generally, a weak bond such as hydrogen bonding, van der Waals’ interactions, etc., is formed between the enzyme and the inhibitor. Strong covalent bonds are rare as they would destroy the enzyme permanently.

qe: Aspartame is one of the most widely used artificial sweeteners, roughly 100 times sweeter than cane sugar. What is its major physical limitation?
qh: एस्पार्टेम सबसे व्यापक रूप से इस्तेमाल किए जाने वाले कृत्रिम मिठास में से एक है, जो गन्ने की चीनी से लगभग 100 गुना अधिक मीठा है। इसकी प्रमुख भौतिक सीमा (physical limitation) क्या है?
o: It requires extremely low pH to dissolve in water.
It is unstable at cooking temperatures, limiting its use to cold foods.
It turns violently bitter when mixed with synthetic food dyes.
It provides massive amounts of unwanted caloric energy.
e: Explanation: The use of aspartame is strictly limited to cold foods and soft drinks because it decomposes and is chemically unstable at cooking temperatures.

qe: Chemically, what is the structural composition of the artificial sweetener Aspartame?
qh: रासायनिक दृष्टि से, कृत्रिम मधुरक एस्पार्टेम की संरचनात्मक संरचना क्या है?
o: A trichloro derivative of natural sucrose
A methyl ester of a dipeptide formed from aspartic acid and phenylalanine
A cyclic polymer of fructose and galactose molecules
e: Explanation: Aspartame is chemically a methyl ester of the dipeptide formed from two amino acids: aspartic acid and phenylalanine.

qe: Sucralose is a popular zero-calorie artificial sweetener that is highly stable at cooking temperatures. Structurally, what is Sucralose?
qh: सुक्रालोज़ एक लोकप्रिय शून्य-कैलोरी कृत्रिम मधुरक है जो खाना पकाने के तापमान पर अत्यधिक स्थिर है। संरचनात्मक रूप से, सुक्रालोज़ क्या है?
o: A sodium salt of a benzenesulphonate
A dipeptide linked with a methyl ester
e: Explanation: Sucralose is chemically a trichloro derivative of sucrose. Its appearance and taste perfectly mimic natural sugar, and it remains completely stable at elevated cooking temperatures.

qe: Receptor proteins are crucial to the body’s communication process. Where is the active binding site of these proteins positionally oriented?
qh: रिसेप्टर प्रोटीन शरीर की संचार प्रक्रिया के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं। इन प्रोटीनों का सक्रिय बाइंडिंग साइट (active binding site) स्थितीय रूप से कहाँ उन्मुख (oriented) होता है?
o: It is deeply buried within the cellular cytoplasm.
It is located exclusively inside the cell nucleus.
It projects out of the membrane and opens on the outside region of the cell.
It is completely detached and floats freely in the extracellular fluid.
e: Explanation: The majority of receptor proteins are embedded in cell membranes. Their small part possessing the active site projects out of the surface of the membrane and opens on the outside region of the cell to receive chemical messengers.

qe: How do chemical messengers successfully transfer critical information into a cell without physically entering it?
qh: रासायनिक संदेशवाहक (chemical messengers) भौतिक रूप से कोशिका में प्रवेश किए बिना उसमें महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी सफलतापूर्वक कैसे स्थानांतरित करते हैं?
o: They dissolve the lipid membrane temporarily to pass signals.
They emit localized electrical pulses that penetrate the nucleus.
They bind to the receptor, causing the receptor site to change shape and transfer the message.
They inject RNA strands through the cellular wall.
e: Explanation: Chemical messengers are received at the binding sites of receptor proteins. To accommodate a messenger, the shape of the receptor site changes. This structural shift brings about the transfer of the message into the cell, meaning the messenger gives the message without entering the cell.

qe: Food preservatives are vital for preventing microbial spoilage. Which of the following everyday chemicals is NOT used as a food preservative?
qh: माइक्रोबियल खराबी को रोकने के लिए खाद्य परिरक्षक (Food preservatives) महत्वपूर्ण हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा रोज़मर्रा का रसायन खाद्य परिरक्षक के रूप में उपयोग नहीं किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: The most commonly used food preservatives include table salt, sugar, vegetable oils, and sodium benzoate. Sodium hydrogencarbonate (baking soda) is an antacid and a leavening agent, not classified as a food preservative.
